content:
**Truthammer — 10 October 2026**

Dain Truthammer begins a countdown: “if you don’t reveal for negotiations we will rain hellfire down upon you”.

The count reaches zero. Tona, in bird form, picks up the goblin flanking the party and drops it in front of the goblins’ fire pit as a warning.

Dain’s earlier promise of no violence remains part of the scene. The goblin’s condition, any damage from the drop and the camp’s response are still unreported.
